CustomSecurityQuestion.title: CustomSecurityQuestion
CustomSecurityQuestion.description: User-authored custom security question prompt text (never answers or keys) collected to improve preset question options in future releases.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user who created the custom question.

questionText.description: Normalized custom question prompt text (5..160 characters). Must never include secret answers.

DiagnosticReport.title: DiagnosticReport
DiagnosticReport.description: Sanitized diagnostic report, system failure log, and voluntary user feedback submitted by the user to the developer database.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the reporting user.

category.description: Recorded issue or diagnostic report category.

sanitizedSummary.description: Sanitized system failure/diagnostic summary without filenames, URIs, or keys (1..1200 characters).

userFeedback.description: User-authored description of the problem or improvement request (0..2000 characters).

healthSnapshot.description: Compact vault and key-mirror health telemetry snapshot (0..800 characters).

deviceModel.description: Sanitized device manufacturer and model (1..80 characters).

occurredAtMillis.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the issue or report occurred.

/custom_security_questions/{questionId}.description: User-submitted custom security question prompts (without secret answers) scoped by userId.

/diagnostic_reports/{reportId}.description: User-submitted sanitized diagnostic reports and recorded system failure summaries scoped by userId.
